# Predicting paired arterial CO2

Enter an observed transcutaneous CO2 reading to estimate simultaneous arterial CO2. The research page links results across settings and contains the agreement comparison and local tools.
Method: future_setting_joint_v1. Public research candidates awaiting independent biostatistical review.
Default input: observed TcCO2 in mmHg and optional measurement setting. The approved summary lookup reports TriNetX-based predictions for All, ICU proxy, ED/inpatient and ambulatory populations across integer readings 20–100 mmHg. Exact prior and full curves remain on the mini. Release approval does not establish clinical validity.
The synthetic example uses the four public fits and an invented fixed prior. Synthetic rows include independently gated conditional variance components. The public TriNetX lookup supplies the median, central 95% interval, and probabilities at or above 45 and 52 mmHg. Advanced local CSV/XLSX priors run in the Python worker.
An offline private viewer can display a custodian-approved empirical prior and posterior at TcCO2 47 mmHg. Its distribution file stays in the approved private workspace. The Pages app uses no backend, telemetry or patient-value URLs. Legacy bootstrap and custom-study analysis are offline.
Source and methods: https://github.com/reblocke/tcco2-accuracy

The public calculator displays the approved summary lookup together with separate rounded fixed-grid drawing coordinates from `models/pages/prediction-plots.json`. The private source curves remain on the mini.
